description: The PUBLIC cross-merchant market catalog: every published checkout across merchants (id, title, price, currency, merchant, domain, payable url). No key. q filters by title/merchant/description.

fields.description: Optional response projection: dot paths to keep, e.g. ["items.title","items.price"] or row-level ["title","price"]. Envelope/meta keys (ok, success, total, count, pagination) are always kept; unknown paths are ignored; empty/absent = full response.

name: uxc_get_market
